_notes.spec 3.2 keys: scoring_thresholds.shape.arm_weight (default 0) and scoring_thresholds.gate.timing_source (default "bounce") are not written above: absent means the default, and lesson / segment config_overrides set them (validated by lesson_package.NEW_CONFIG_KEYS). The other new sections (retarget, tolerance) are written out with their defaults.
_notes.scoring_thresholds.shape.arm_weight: Default 0 (off). Share of the shape score given to the arms: the mean angle (deg) between learner and reference torso-frame unit bone vectors (both upper arms and forearms) at the -0.12/0/+0.12 s samples. The other shape weights are scaled by (1 - arm_weight). Range [0, 1].
_notes.scoring_thresholds.gate.timing_source: Default "bounce". "bounce": the timing gate uses knee-bounce turnarounds (min_good_or_better_beat_ratio of beats Good or better). "hits": it uses the settle-after-move hits instead (on_beat_ratio >= min_good_or_better_beat_ratio; a reference without hits never fails), and bounce timing is informational.
_notes.scoring_thresholds.retarget.enabled: Default false. Re-walk the reference (and golden takes) from root along CANONICAL_BONES with the teacher's unit bone directions and the learner's bone lengths: the median over the attempt's calibration_frames (a calibration stance) when given, else over the take. Joint angles are unchanged by it; joint positions are not.
_notes.scoring_thresholds.tolerance.velocity_sc: Default 0 (off). alpha in s/rad: a joint verdict's tolerance on a beat is tau_base * min(velocity_max_factor, 1 + alpha * |omega_j(t)|), omega_j being the reference's angular velocity (rad/s) of the bone ending at joint j (positions) or of the joint angle (knees, elbows), from poses at t -/+ velocity_half_window_s.
_notes.scoring_thresholds.tolerance.velocity_ma: Default 3.0. Upper clamp of the velocity tolerance factor.
_notes.scoring_thresholds.tolerance.velocity_ha: Default 0.05 s. Half-width of the central difference for omega_j.
_notes.scoring_thresholds.tolerance.occlusion: A joint is occluded on a beat when its confidence in the nearest reference or learner frame is < min_confidence (default 0.5; a missing confidence counts as 1), and both wrists are when the wrists are closer than wrist_distance leg lengths in either pose (default 0 = off). An occluded joint's tolerance is multiplied by factor (default 1 = off), or with mask=true (default false) its beat is left out.
_notes.lesson windows: Reference clips may carry the manifest windows (lesson_package.slice_reference / stretch): a window whose mask lists hand_shape drops the hand-styling samples inside it, and its tolerance_scale multiplies those joints' verdict tolerances on the beats inside it.
